name: pop
title: Population
description: Annual population estimates for Bolivia's 339 municipalities, 2001–2020: gridded population counts summed over each municipality. They are the denominators for per-capita indicators such as night-time lights per capita.

geo:citation: GeoDevelopment Observatory of Bolivia (2026). Population (339 municipalities, 2001–2020). https://github.com/quarcs-lab/geo4bolivia/blob/main/docs/datasets/pop.md
geo:notes: The counts were computed by DS4Bolivia on its own municipal polygons, geoBoundaries v4 polygons that differ slightly from the geoBoundaries gbOpen boundaries in geo/boundaries/; `asdf_id` keeps the DS4Bolivia polygon ID.

DS4Bolivia's population README does not name the gridded product; its Earth Engine workflow (apps/geoexplorer1v100bolivia.js, code/aggregate-satellite-embedings-to-adm-pop-weighted1.js) uses WorldPop 100 m, which covers 2000–2020.
These are gridded estimates, not the official INE projections. The SDG dataset carries the Atlas population for 2020 (`sdg.population_2020`), which differs.

resources.geo:source_geometry: DS4Bolivia polygons (bolivia339geoqueryFull, keyed by asdf_id), matched one-to-one to the 339 municipalities by area overlap

fields.name: geo_id
fields.title: Municipality ID
fields.description: Municipality geo ID (BO-DD-PP-MM) of the 339-unit municipality map, numbered as in GADM 4.1; its boundary in geo/boundaries/ comes from geoBoundaries (GeoBolivia, public domain). It nests by prefix into the department (BO-DD) and province (BO-DD-PP) IDs; department and province numbers follow GADM order and differ from INE codes.

fields.name: asdf_id
fields.title: DS4Bolivia polygon ID
fields.description: ID (AidData asdf_id) of the geoBoundaries v4 ADM3 polygon on which DS4Bolivia computed the data, matched one-to-one to the municipality by area overlap.

fields.name: pop
fields.title: Population
fields.description: Estimated number of people living in the municipality: the sum over its polygon of the WorldPop unconstrained global population mosaic at 1 km (aggregated from 100 m random-forest dasymetric estimates; not UN-adjusted), extracted with AidData GeoQuery. Gridded estimates, not INE's official projections.

fields.name: pop_density
fields.title: Population density (people per km²)
fields.description: Population (pop) divided by the municipality's area in km², measured on its geoBoundaries boundary (geo/boundaries/) in the project's equal-area projection (an Albers projection fitted to Bolivia). The salt flats and lakes that lie outside every municipality (Uyuni, Coipasa, Poopó, Uru Uru) are not counted.
fields.geo:source: WorldPop via DS4Bolivia; areas from geoBoundaries (GeoBolivia)
